Draw a background layer for a 2D side-scrolling game. It is a flat, orthographic elevation view, exactly perpendicular, like a theater backdrop: NO perspective, NO vanishing point, NO road going into the distance.
- A dark medieval holy capital seen from the side: rows of steep stone rooftops and spires across the whole width, and one huge gothic cathedral with tall towers and a large round rose window in the middle distance
- Columns of black smoke rising into a dark night sky, a faint crimson glow on the horizon, a few torn crimson banners on the towers
- Colors: obsidian black, deep crimson, faded gold. No neon or fluorescent colors
- Dark and low contrast so characters in front stand out
- The left edge and the right edge must connect seamlessly so the image can tile horizontally
- No crosses anywhere; the only symbol is a simple round golden sun emblem
- No blood, no gore. Wide landscape image, 16:9. No text, no logos, no watermark, no people, no characters
